claimFailedTransfer(address,uint256).details: Only the intended recipient (account) can claim their own failed transfers

params.token: The token to claim (address(0) for native ETH)

params.allowedOFTs_: OFT addresses allowed to bypass pool check (empty = pool-only mode)
params.tokenMessaging_: The Stargate V2 TokenMessaging address for pool verification

returns._0: The array of allowed OFT addresses

handleCompose(bytes32,bytes,address,uint.details: MUST only be called by this contract (self-call from lzCompose)V2 format: decodes compact 2-field payload (initData, sigData) and extracts      account, executorCalldata, dstTokens, intentAmounts from sigData's DstProof.info

params._message: The full OFTComposeMsgCodec-encoded message including header
params.amountLD: The amount in local decimals extracted from the compose header
params.composeFrom: The source chain sender address (fallback claimant)
params.tokenSent: The resolved token address from the Stargate pool

lzCompose(address,bytes32,bytes,address,.details: Decodes the compact 2-field compose message, extracts fields from sigData,      transfers tokens to the target account, and forwards to SuperDestinationExecutor.Credit-or-revert (see contract NatSpec): after sender validation it reverts only on the gas      floor (MIN_LZCOMPOSE_GAS); otherwise it completes, and any failure inside handleCompose is      absorbed by the outer catch, which credits composeFrom in failedTransfers for self-claim. A      revert leaves the compose re-deliverable (EndpointV2's RECEIVED write reverts with it).

params._executor: The address of the executor for the composed message
params._extraData: Additional arbitrary data passed by the executor
params._from: The address initiating the composition (destination OApp/pool, NOT the source chain sender)
params._guid: The unique identifier for the corresponding LayerZero src/dst tx
